Name: StonerVille Mod
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[b][u][size=6]🌿✨ StonerVille ✨🌿[/size][/u][/b]
[u][i]A cozy, magical marijuana-themed expansion for Stardew Valley 1.6 💚[/i][/u]

🚧 STILL A WORK IN PROGRESS! 🚧
🗓️ NEW CONTENT & UPDATES ARRIVE EVERY MONTH! 🗓️
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[u][b]🌈 WHAT IS IT?[/b][/u]
Grow 18 custom strains 🌱 (including 6 you breed yourself 🧬), process them in dozens of hand-drawn machines ⚙️, roll joints 🚬, press rosin 🍯, grind, press hash 🧱, sell to your neighbors 💰, take orders by letter 💌, keep an eye on your Dealer Rep with a sticky note 📝, share a hookah with the villagers 🪷, and throw the Higher Vibez Festival 🎉. All wrapped in a COMPLETE green-to-lilac tie-dye UI 🌈 with an animated main menu 🍃
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💰 Always affordable: seeds 20-45g (Chocolate Mint 120g), machines 150-350g at Pierre's.
🎮 Mouse, keyboard AND controller all work.
🌍 Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Lilybrook & other villager mods.
🚫 Kids & teens are never involved in anything smoking-related.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/u][/b]
• 🧩 SMAPI 4.x
• 📦 Content Patcher
• 🎮 Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
• ✨ Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu
📁 ONE download, ONE folder: StonerVille_AllInOne (content pack + C# add-on). Drop the whole folder into Mods!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🌱 THE GROW LOOP[/u][/b]
🌱 Plant → 🌿 Harvest → ☀️ Dry on a Rack → 🫙 Cure in a Jar → 💨 Smoke it, 💰 sell it, 🍪 bake it, or ✨ craft something better!
• 🍃 8 core strains: Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet, Chocolate Mint
• ❄️ 4 winter strains: Frostbite Kush, Snowcap Haze, Peppermint Frost, Golden Eggnog (they only grow in Winter)
• 🧬 6 hybrids you breed yourself (see Crossbreeding below)
• 🍫 Chocolate Mint is the rare one. Its seeds unlock at Dealer Rep 3!
• 🌸 Fresh, Dried & Cured buds for every strain. Cured buds are gold quality!
• 📦 Batch processing: Racks, Jars, the Rosin Press, the Grinder & the Rolling Table take your whole stack. N in, N out (20 / 10 / 6 / 4 / 2 / 1)
• 🎛️ Config: seed prices, growing seasons, drying, curing & cooking times
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🧬 CROSSBREEDING (NEW!)[/u][/b]
Build a Cross Station (Cabinet or Terrarium look, your choice!). Put in one cured bud, then a cured bud of a different strain. 3 days later out come seeds!
• 🌟 Berry Dream = Strawberry Cough + Blue Dream
• 🌟 Tropical Sunset = Pineapple Express + Sunset Sherbet
• 🌟 Cookies & Cream = Girl Scout Cookies + Snowcap Haze
• 🌟 Frosted Lemon = Lemon Haze + Frostbite Kush
• 🌟 Golden Aurora = Northern Lights + Golden Eggnog
• 🌟 Peppermint Punch = Peppermint Frost + Strawberry Cough
• 💌 Make a hybrid for the first time and a discovery note arrives in your mail
• 🎲 Any other pair gives 2 seeds of one of the parents
• 🍯 Every hybrid has the full chain: buds, joints, edibles, rosin, hash and more
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]💌 LETTERS & ORDERS (BIG UPDATE!)[/u][/b]
Your mailbox is now your order desk! Every request arrives as a LETTER, and every letter is kept in your Letters (collections tab) so you can re-read it any time.
• 🖼️ Each letter shows the villager's portrait, what they want, how many, the exact gold they will pay and the day it is due
• 🌿 Villagers only ask for what is IN SEASON, so you are never asked for something you can't grow or make
• 🌸 Plain bud is always requested CURED. Others ask for joints, edibles, tea and (later) concentrates
• 📅 Every Monday (from day 7) up to 4 villagers who like you (2+ hearts) write a regular order
• ✅ Fill an order two ways: hold the items, talk to the villager and choose Fill order, OR use the town boards (below)
• 💰 Pay = sell price + a bonus that grows with your Dealer Rep. Happy customers like you more
• 🗣️ 30 cozy request lines and 20 thank-yous, so letters never feel copy-pasted
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🪧 BUYER NOTICES ON THE TOWN BOARDS (NEW!)[/u][/b]
Walk up to the Help Wanted board OR the Special Orders board by Pierre's and choose Buyer notices. Your open orders pin up as notes with a Fill button that hands in the items straight from your backpack. Works with mouse, keyboard and controller!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🛍️ SELL TO YOUR NEIGHBORS[/u][/b]
Hold any StonerVille product and talk to an adult villager: Share it / Sell it / Give as gift.
• 📈 Price grows with your Dealer Rep (+10% up to +50%) and with how much they like the item
• 🚫 Villagers who dislike it won't buy. Up to 2 items per villager per day
• 🏪 Pierre buys as a shopkeeper at the normal price
• 🌍 Every adult villager from vanilla and modded towns can be sold to (kids & teens never)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🕴️ DEALER ORDERS & REPUTATION[/u][/b]
12 dealer orders arrive as letters from Pam, Shane, Leah, Sebastian, Willy, Gus & Marnie (the first lands after day 5, the next the day after you finish the last). Each asks for cured bud of a strain that is in season.
• 🌱 Rep 1: starting out, customers pay +10%
• 📈 Rep 2 after order 3: +20% and the Cross Station
• 🍫 Rep 3 after order 6: +30%, Chocolate Mint seeds, the Hash Press
• 🎁 Rep 4 after order 9: +40% and the Packing Table
• 👑 Kingpin after order 12: +50%, the top of the valley
• 💌 Every rise comes with a story letter
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]📝 THE DEALER REP STICKY NOTE (NEW!)[/u][/b]
Not sure where you stand? A sticky note lives in the LOWER RIGHT corner of your screen once your first dealer order arrives. It always shows:
• 🏷️ Your Dealer Rep level
• 💰 How much customers pay at your level
• ➡️ How many more orders until the next level
• ⭕ 12 little squares that fill in as you complete orders
• 📮 Your current open order
It hides itself during menus, cutscenes and festivals, so it never gets in the way.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]⚙️ MACHINES[/u][/b]
• 🪜 Drying Rack & Dark Wood Rack · 150g
• 🫙 Curing Jar · 250g
• 🫧 Bong & Pastel Bong · 350g
• 🌈 Hippie & Pastel Seed Makers · 150g
• 🍯 Rosin Press · 300g
• 💎 Dab Rig & Pastel Dab Rig · 350g (load Rosin, get a Dab Hit buff)
• 🧈 Infusion Pot · 200g (1 dried bud + any milk = Cannabutter)
• 🪑 Rolling Table · 200g & 📜 Rolling Papers · 20g
• 🍪 Edibles Oven · 150g & ✨ Golden Oven · 250g (butter edibles)
• ⚙️ Grinder · 250g (cured bud to Ground Flower to Kief)
• 🧱 Hash Press · 300g (Rep 3) and 🎁 Packing Table · 200g (Rep 4) for Hash and Gift Baskets
• 🧬 Cross Station (Cabinet & Terrarium) · 350g (Rep 2)
• 🪷 Trippy Hookah · 600g, 2x2 (see below)
• 🫙 Stash Jar · 200g (a chest you can carry) with strain labels, and 📚 Stash Shelf & Lilac Shelf · 250g (display 4 jars each)
• 🏕️ Garden Tent · 300g at Robin's, two grow slots, grows in about 60% of the time
• 🚬 Ashtray · 200g (5 Roaches = a Roach Joint)
🍪 Edibles: Brownie, Cookie, Gummies, Swirl Lollipop and Calm Tea, plus Butter versions, each with its own buff. Every strain makes exactly one edible.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🛍️ EVERYTHING YOU CAN MAKE[/u][/b][i]
🌿 FROM EVERY STRAIN (18 of them!)
[/i]• 🌱 Seeds → 🌸 Fresh bud → ☀️ Dried bud → ✨ Cured bud (gold quality)
• 🚬 A unique Joint for each strain, with its own look & buff
• 🍪 One edible per strain
⚙️ FROM YOUR MACHINES
• 🍯 Rosin (Rosin Press) and 💎 Dab Hits (Dab Rigs)
• ⚪ Ground Flower and 🌫️ Kief (Grinder)
• 🧱 Hash (Hash Press)
• 🧈 Cannabutter (Infusion Pot) and Butter Edibles (Golden Oven)
• 🍪 Brownies, Cookies, Gummies, Swirl Lollipops & Calm Tea (Edibles Oven)
• 🍂 Blunts, 🍫 Dealer's Special, 🎁 Pre-roll Packs, 🪙 Roach Joints (Rolling Table & Ashtray)
• 🎁 Gift Baskets (Packing Table)
• 🧬 Seeds of brand-new hybrids (Cross Station)
• 🫧 Bong rips (Bong & Pastel Bong)
• 🪷 Hookah sessions with friends
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🚬 ROLL YOUR OWN[/u][/b]
• 🌿 A joint for every strain, each with its own look & buff
• 🍂 Blunt: 2 cured buds, a big 10 minute buff
• 🍫 Dealer's Special: 2 cured Chocolate Mint, the best there is
• 🎁 Pre-roll Pack: 5 joints in a tube
• 🪙 Roaches & Lighters: sometimes a roach is left behind, and a Lighter makes buffs last 25% longer
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🫶 SHARE A JOINT & 🪷 THE HOOKAH[/u][/b]
• Hold a joint, blunt or Dealer's Special and interact with an adult villager. Some LOVE it, some join in, some politely decline (nothing lost!)
• 👀 Joiners get a touch of redness in their eyes on the portrait, during their reply only
• 🪷 The Trippy Hookah: take a rip with a cured bud and up to 3 friendly adults nearby join your circle with a groovy line. A small farming buff for you, friendship for them!
• ☁️ Every smokable plays a fluffy cloud & rainbow sparkle effect
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🎉 THE HIGHER VIBEZ FESTIVAL (Summer 7)[/u][/b]
• 🎪 A tie-dye stage, jumbo animated lava lamps, speakers that pulse, a market and a decor stall, balloon arches, bean bags and mushroom stools
• 🏆 Smoking contest: hold the button, release in the sweet zone. 1st place wins 500g, rare seeds and the Golden Spliff Trophy
• 🍽️ Free buffet with the Munchies Satisfied buff, a Snack Table shop, and a west court with bongs
• 🎡 Main square: Prize Wheel (first spin free, jackpot is Hash), Photo Booth (saves a tie-dye photo and gives a Luck buff), a big hookah and 12 tie-dye bean bags
• 🎤 Guests Dawgy Kong, Chonk & Cheeba, plus surprise celebs Granny Bloom, DJ Haze & Professor Puff at noon. Share a joint with them for a prize!
• 💃 Villagers dance, nap, browse the stalls, chat and cheer. Every adult attends in festival accessories
• 💌 An invitation letter arrives on Summer 6
• ✅ Works with heavily modded Town maps
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🏡 DECOR, WEARABLES & MORE[/u][/b]
• 🌋 8 Lava Lamps with flowing lava, a click to switch them on or off (flicker fixed!)
• 🛏️ Hippie Leaf Bed replaces your starter bed
• 🪴 4 Hanging Plants and 4 Incense Burners with real smoke (floor or table)
• 🛋️ Slouch Beanbag, Tie-Dye Rug, Blacklight Poster, Bead Curtain (hangs over windows), Wind Chimes, Party Speaker
• 🕶️ Hippy Glasses (drawn on your face!), Hemp Hoodie & Pastel Hoodie
• 💌 A starter letter from Pierre with seeds
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🌈 THE COMPLETE GREEN-TO-LILAC UI (NEW!)[/u][/b]
A full tie-dye recolor of the whole interface! Turn it on in Generic Mod Config Menu (or type stonerville_ui on in the SMAPI console), turn it off any time if you use another UI mod.
• 💚💜 Every menu page fades from kush green to lilac: inventory, skills, social, map, crafting, collections, options and more
• 🌈 A rainbow trim and pot leaves on the corners of every big menu
• 🗂️ Tabs, buttons, the clock, the gold box, the quest button and the toolbar all match. No orange left behind!
• 🍃 Over 200 menu pictures recolored. Nothing from the base game is shipped, it is all done while you play
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🎬 THE ANIMATED MAIN MENU (NEW!)[/u][/b]
• 🍃 Pot leaves AND the fresh buds of every strain we offer drift down the title screen, swaying and spinning
• 💜 The whole screen fades from green to lilac, with a purple glow behind the Stardew Valley logo
• 🌿 Big pot leaves frame the New, Load, Co-op and Exit buttons
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]🛠️ INSTALL[/u][/b]
1. Install SMAPI & Content Patcher.
2. 🗑️ DELETE any old Mods/StonerVille and Mods/StonerVilleGlasses folders first!
3. Unzip & drop StonerVille_AllInOne into your Mods folder.
4. Play & shop at Pierre's! 🛒
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u]📝 NOTES[/u][/b]
• 🚧 Work in progress, updated every month. Suggestions welcome in the comments! 💬
• 🧩 Glasses, Stash Jar/Shelf, smoke effects, hand-selling, hookah, festival, orders & crossbreeding use the included add-on. If one fails, only that feature turns off.
• 🔍 If something looks wrong, send me your SMAPI log. Typing patch summary in the console also helps.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[i]💚 Made with love by Nesryn Astra Rose 💚[/i]

Manifest.Name: StonerVille Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds twelve weed-style crops with seeds at Pierre's, processing machines (Drying Rack, Curing Jar, Rolling Table, Rosin Press, Infusion Pot, Edibles Oven, Dab Rigs, Bong), edibles, joints, dealer letters and orders, Share a Joint with villagers, lava lamps, a Garden Tent, stash shelves and jars, incense burners, wall decor and an optional UI recolor. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and Almanac mods.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
